_source: ADR 0027, plan 0018 step 1: the nodes the pull, the run and the switch-off move. Each is an empty node named by its id under its part's node, at the point the game moves it about; a mesh node's shape hangs under it as a child named <id>.mesh, so mesh compression (which rescales mesh nodes) never moves the empty. Read by tools/blender/common.py and tools/pipeline/check.ts.
